topic.source_contract: adopted charging schedule, indexed rate, chargeable development, floorspace, relief, liability, commencement, collection, payment, spending and reporting evidence

scope_guards: A draft charging schedule is not treated as adopted and effective.
A published rate is not treated as a calculated liability for a development.
A liability notice is not treated as payment.
A relief application is not treated as granted relief.
Planning permission is not treated as lawful commencement.
An infrastructure list is not treated as funded or delivered infrastructure.
An annual report is not treated as evidence of benefit to an exact parcel.
No score or promotion is written without exact schedule, liability, relief, commencement, payment and infrastructure-delivery evidence.
